title: 实验 3-7 · 三要素法 + 戴维宁：电容旁边并一个电阻
summary: 在 RC 电路的电容两端再并一个 10 kΩ：终值减半、时间常数也减半。再学一个用示波器读数反算 τ 的办法。
concepts: 戴维宁等效电阻 Thévenin resistance
由 VH/VL 求 τ measuring τ from the swing
description: **目标**：电容不是直接串一个电阻接电源时，用三要素法和戴维宁等效电阻求时间常数，并学会从示波器读数反算 τ。
**电路**：信号发生器红夹子 → R1（10 kΩ）→ 结点 VC；VC 到 GND 之间并联 C1（100 nF）和 R2（10 kΩ）。黑夹子接 GND。
**信号发生器**：方波，幅度 2.5 V、偏置 2.5 V（0 ↔ 5 V）。**示波器**：CH1 看 VIN，CH2 看 VC。
**先预测**：用三要素法 u_C(t) = u(∞) + [u(0+) − u(∞)]·e^(−t/τ)，自己求出三个要素，再估计 100 Hz 和 1 kHz 时 VC 的波形：
- **终值 u(∞)**：电容开路，R1 和 R2 分压。别忘了 R1 要加上信号发生器的 50 Ω。
- **时间常数 τ = R_eq·C**：R_eq 是从电容两端看进去的戴维宁电阻（电压源置零）。
- **初值 u(0+)**：电容电压不能突变，等于上一个半周期结束时的值。
放电半周期也一样：方波为 0 V 时 u(∞) = 0，从电容看进去的电阻不变，τ 也不变。
**测量**：先用 100 Hz 看 VC 的最高值；再换 1 kHz，读出 VC 的最高值 VH 和最低值 VL。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**动手**：在板上测出 VH、VL，自己算一次 τ；然后把 R2 拔掉，猜一猜 VH、VL 会变成多少（提示：回到实验 3-1 的情况，τ 变成 ≈ 1 ms，终值 5 V）。
**真实电路里**：常见瓷片电容的容值误差是 ±10%～±20%，所以实际测出的 τ 和用标称值算出的差一两成很正常；用读数反算 τ 正好可以把电容的实际值测出来。

en.title: Experiment 3-7 · Three-element method + Thévenin: a resistor across the capacitor
en.summary: Add a 10 kΩ across the capacitor of an RC circuit: the final value halves and so does the time constant. Plus a way to work out τ from scope readings.
concepts: measuring τ from the swing VH/VL
description: **Goal**: when the capacitor is not simply in series with one resistor, find the time constant with the three-element method and the Thévenin resistance, and learn to work τ out from scope readings.
**Circuit**: generator red clip → R1 (10 kΩ) → node VC; between VC and GND, C1 (100 nF) and R2 (10 kΩ) in parallel. Black clip to GND.
**Generator**: square wave, amplitude 2.5 V, offset 2.5 V (0 ↔ 5 V). **Scope**: CH1 on VIN, CH2 on VC.
**Predict first**: with the three-element method u_C(t) = u(∞) + [u(0+) − u(∞)]·e^(−t/τ), find each element yourself, then sketch VC at 100 Hz and at 1 kHz:
- **Final value u(∞)**: capacitor open, R1 and R2 form a divider. Don't forget to add the generator's 50 Ω to R1.
- **Time constant τ = R_eq·C**: R_eq is the Thévenin resistance seen from the capacitor's terminals (sources set to zero).
- **Initial value u(0+)**: the capacitor voltage cannot jump, so it is the value at the end of the previous half period.
The discharging half period works the same way: with the square wave at 0 V, u(∞) = 0 and the capacitor sees the same resistance, so τ is unchanged.

**Measure**: at 100 Hz read the highest value of VC; then at 1 kHz read its highest value VH and lowest value VL. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.
**Try it**: read VH and VL on your board and compute τ yourself; then pull R2 out and predict the new VH and VL (hint: you're back to Experiment 3-1, τ ≈ 1 ms, final value 5 V).

**In a real circuit**: common ceramic capacitors have a ±10% to ±20% tolerance, so a measured τ 10–20% away from the nominal value is normal; working τ out from the readings is exactly how you measure the capacitor's real value.
compare: - u(∞) = 5 V × 10 k / (10.05 k + 10 k) ≈ 2.49 V — not 5 V! R_eq = (10.05 k) ∥ (10 k) ≈ 5.01 kΩ, so τ ≈ 5.01 kΩ × 100 nF ≈ 0.50 ms — half of the plain series RC.
- **100 Hz (half period 5 ms ≈ 10τ)**: the final value is reached every time; VC swings between 0 and ≈ 2.49 V.
- **1 kHz (half period 0.5 ms ≈ τ)**: VC swings between VL ≈ 0.67 V and VH ≈ 1.82 V, centred on u(∞)/2 ≈ 1.25 V.

**Working τ out from the readings**: discharging from VH towards 0, the voltage reaches exactly VL after T/2, so VL = VH·e^(−T/(2τ)), i.e. τ = (T/2) / ln(VH/VL) = 0.5 ms / ln(1.82/0.67) ≈ 0.50 ms. You don't need the final value or a start from 0, and it works at any frequency (at 2 kHz, VH ≈ 1.55 V and VL ≈ 0.94 V still give ≈ 0.50 ms).

measurements.ask: 100 Hz: the highest value of CH2 (VC), i.e. the final value u(∞)
measurements.explain: Capacitor open, (R1 + 50 Ω) and R2 divide: 5 × 10 / 20.05 ≈ 2.49 V, not 5 V.

measurements.ask: 1 kHz: the highest value of VC, VH
1 kHz: the lowest value of VC, VL
measurements.explain: A 0.5 ms half period ≈ τ, so VC swings between VL and VH, centred on u(∞)/2 ≈ 1.25 V.

measurements.ask: Discharging from VH, VC reaches VL exactly T/2 later: from your readings, τ = (T/2) / ln(VH/VL)
measurements.explain: R_eq = (10.05 k) ∥ (10 k) ≈ 5.01 kΩ, τ = R_eq·C ≈ 0.50 ms, half the plain series RC value. The method needs no final value and works at any frequency.

measurements.ask: With C = 100 nF, the resistance the capacitor sees, R_eq = τ / C
measurements.explain: ≈ 5.0 kΩ = (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2: with the source zeroed, R1 and R2 are in parallel as seen from the capacitor.

hints: C1 and R2 both go from VC to GND, side by side.
Final value: a divider of (R1 + 50 Ω) and R2. τ: (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2, times C.
tests: 100 Hz: the final value is reached every half period; discharges to ≈ 0
1 kHz: sensible VH and VL (τ set by R1 ∥ R2)
2 kHz: a smaller swing, the same average

tests.name: 100 Hz：每半周期都走到终值，放电到 ≈ 0
1 kHz：VH、VL 合理（τ 由 R1 ∥ R2 决定）

compare: - **100 Hz（半周期 5 ms ≈ 10τ）**：每次都走到终值，VC 在 0 和 ≈ 2.49 V 之间。
- **1 kHz（半周期 0.5 ms ≈ τ）**：VC 在 VL ≈ 0.67 V 和 VH ≈ 1.82 V 之间来回，中心是 u(∞)/2 ≈ 1.25 V。

**用读数反算 τ**：放电半周期从 VH 指数衰减到 0 的过程中，经过 T/2 时恰好到 VL，所以 VL = VH·e^(−T/(2τ))，即 τ = (T/2) / ln(VH/VL) = 0.5 ms / ln(1.82/0.67) ≈ 0.50 ms。这个办法不需要知道终值，也不需要从 0 开始，任何频率都能用（2 kHz 时 VH ≈ 1.55 V、VL ≈ 0.94 V，算出来还是 ≈ 0.50 ms）。

measurements.ask: 100 Hz：CH2（VC）的最高值，也就是终值 u(∞)

measurements.explain: 半周期 0.5 ms ≈ τ，VC 在 VL 和 VH 之间来回，中心是 u(∞)/2 ≈ 1.25 V。

measurements.ask: 放电半周期从 VH 衰减，经过 T/2 正好到 VL：用你的读数算 τ = (T/2) / ln(VH/VL)
measurements.explain: R_eq = (10.05 k) ∥ (10 k) ≈ 5.01 kΩ，τ = R_eq·C ≈ 0.50 ms，只有 RC 串联时的一半。这个方法不需要知道终值，任何频率都能用。

measurements.ask: 再用 C = 100 nF 算从电容看进去的等效电阻 R_eq = τ / C
measurements.explain: ≈ 5.0 kΩ = (R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2：电压源置零后，R1 和 R2 从电容看过去是并联的。

hints: C1 和 R2 都从 VC 接到 GND，并排放。
终值：(R1 + 50 Ω) 和 R2 分压；τ：(R1 + 50 Ω) ∥ R2，再乘 C。
